title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Assume exactly one solution exists.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i, return the max profit from one buy and one sell. Return 0 if no profit possible.

title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice, and false if every element is distinct.

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is the product of all elements except nums[i], without using division.

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.

title: Maximum Product Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums, find a contiguous subarray that has the largest product, and return the product.

title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Given the sorted, rotated array nums of unique elements, return the minimum element. Must run in O(log n).

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Given a rotated sorted array nums of distinct integers and a target, return the index of target or -1. Must run in O(log n).

title: 3Sum
description: Given an integer array nums, return all unique triplets [nums[i],nums[j],nums[k]] that sum to 0.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and return the resulting non-overlapping array.

title: Insert Interval
description: Given a set of non-overlapping intervals sorted by start, insert a new interval and merge if necessary. Return resulting array.

title: Rotate Array
description: Given an array nums, rotate the array to the right by k steps, and return the rotated array.

title: Set Matrix Zeroes
description: Given an m x n matrix, if an element is 0, set its entire row and column to 0. Return the modified matrix.

title: Spiral Matrix
description: Given an m x n matrix, return all elements of the matrix in spiral order.

title: Rotate Image
description: Given an n x n 2D matrix, rotate it by 90 degrees clockwise in place, and return the matrix.

title: Word Search
description: Given an m x n grid of characters board and a string word, return true if word exists in the grid, constructed from adjacent cells (horizontally or vertically), not reusing a cell.

title: First Missing Positive
description: Given an unsorted integer array nums, return the smallest missing positive integer, in O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

title: Jump Game
description: Given an array of non-negative integers nums, you start at index 0. Each element represents the max jump length from that position. Return true if you can reach the last index.

title: Jump Game II
description: Given an array of non-negative integers nums, you are at index 0. Return the minimum number of jumps to reach the last index (guaranteed reachable).

title: Container With Most Water
description: Given n non-negative integers height where each represents a line at that index, find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container holding the most water. Return the max area.

title: Next Permutation
description: Given an array of integers nums, rearrange to the next lexicographically greater permutation. If not possible, rearrange as the lowest possible order.

title: Gas Station
description: There are n gas stations along a circular route. gas[i] fuel at station i, cost[i] to travel to next. Return the starting index to complete the circuit, or -1 if impossible (guaranteed unique if exists).

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise.

title: Valid Palindrome
description: Given a string s, considering only alphanumeric characters and ignoring case, return true if it is a palindrome.

examples.input: s='A man, a plan, a canal: Panama'

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring in s. If multiple answers of the same max length exist, return the leftmost.

title: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings strs, group the anagrams together. Return groups sorted for determinism (each group sorted, groups sorted).

title: String to Integer (atoi)
description: Implement atoi: convert a string to a 32-bit signed integer, following the described whitespace/sign/digit/clamping rules.

title: Generate Parentheses
description: Given n pairs of parentheses, return all combinations of well-formed parentheses, sorted lexicographically.

title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
description: Given a string of digits 2-9, return all possible letter combinations the number could represent (telephone keypad), sorted lexicographically.

title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. Return empty string if none.

title: Isomorphic Strings
description: Given two strings s and t, determine if they are isomorphic: characters in s can be replaced to get t, with a consistent one-to-one mapping.

title: Word Break
description: Given a string s and a dictionary of strings wordDict, return true if s can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of dictionary words.

title: Minimum Window Substring
description: Given strings s and t, return the minimum window substring of s such that every character in t (including duplicates) is included. Return '' if no such substring exists.

title: Decode String
description: Given an encoded string in form k[encoded_string], return the decoded string, where the encoded string inside brackets is repeated k times.

title: Multiply Strings
description: Given two non-negative integers num1 and num2 represented as strings, return the product of num1 and num2, also represented as a string, without using built-in big-integer conversion directly.

title: Palindromic Substrings
description: Given a string s, return the number of palindromic substrings in it (different positions count separately even if same characters).

title: Two Sum Using Hashmap
description: Given an integer array nums and target, return the indices of two numbers adding up to target using a hashmap-based approach for O(n) time.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, return the total number of subarrays whose sum equals k.

title: Top K Frequent Elements
description: Given an integer array nums and integer k, return the k most frequent elements. Ties broken by smaller value first.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Given an unsorted array of integers nums, return the length of the longest sequence of consecutive elements, in O(n) time.

title: Word Pattern
description: Given a pattern and a string s, find if s follows the same pattern: a bijection between letters of pattern and words of s.

title: Happy Number
description: A happy number is defined by replacing the number with the sum of squares of its digits repeatedly until it equals 1 (happy) or loops forever (not happy). Return true if n is happy.

title: 4Sum II
description: Given four integer arrays of equal length n, return the number of tuples (i,j,k,l) such that nums1[i]+nums2[j]+nums3[k]+nums4[l] == 0.

title: Ransom Note
description: Given strings ransomNote and magazine, return true if ransomNote can be constructed from letters in magazine (each letter used once).

title: Two Sum IV via Traversal
description: Given the inorder traversal values of a BST as nums and an integer k, return true if there exist two elements summing to k.

title: Majority Element
description: Given an array nums of size n, return the majority element that appears more than n/2 times (guaranteed to exist).

title: First Unique Character in a String
description: Given a string s, find the first non-repeating character and return its index. If none exists, return -1.

title: Count Unique Anagram Groups
description: Given a list of strings strs, return the number of distinct anagram groups.

title: Contains Duplicate II
description: Given an integer array nums and integer k, return true if there are two distinct indices i,j such that nums[i]==nums[j] and abs(i-j) <= k.

title: Sort Elements By Frequency
description: Given an integer array nums, return the distinct elements sorted by decreasing frequency; ties broken by smaller value first.

title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
description: Given a 1-indexed sorted array numbers, find two numbers that add up to target. Return their 1-indexed positions as [index1, index2].

title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
description: Given a sorted array nums, remove duplicates in place such that each unique element appears once, and return the number of unique elements (k).

title: Move Zeroes
description: Given an integer array nums, move all 0's to the end while maintaining the relative order of non-zero elements. Return the resulting array.

title: Is Subsequence
description: Given strings s and t, return true if s is a subsequence of t (characters of s appear in t in order, not necessarily contiguous).

title: Sort Colors
description: Given an array nums with values 0,1,2 representing colors, sort in place so same colors are adjacent in order 0,1,2. Return the sorted array.

title: Backspace String Compare
description: Given strings s and t, both containing '#' as a backspace character, return true if they are equal after applying backspaces.

title: Reverse String
description: Given a string s, return the string with characters reversed.

title: Squares of a Sorted Array
description: Given an integer array nums sorted in non-decreasing order, return an array of the squares of each number, sorted in non-decreasing order.

title: Valid Palindrome II
description: Given a string s, return true if it can be a palindrome after deleting at most one character.

title: Partition Labels
description: Given a string s, partition it into as many parts as possible so each letter appears in at most one part. Return a list of the sizes of these parts.

title: Boats to Save People
description: Given weights of people and a boat weight limit (each boat carries at most 2 people, sum must be <= limit), return the minimum number of boats needed.

title: Merge Sorted Array
description: Given two sorted integer arrays nums1 (first m elements valid) and nums2 (n elements), merge nums2 into nums1 as one sorted array; return the merged sorted array of length m+n.

title: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of size k.

title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
description: Given a string s and integer k, you can replace up to k characters. Return the length of the longest substring containing the same letter after replacements.

title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
description: Given an array of positive integers nums and a positive integer target, return the minimal length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is >= target, or 0 if none exists.

title: Permutation in String
description: Given two strings s1 and s2, return true if s2 contains a permutation of s1 as a contiguous substring.

title: Find All Anagrams in a String
description: Given strings s and p, return an array of all start indices of p's anagrams in s.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
description: Given an array nums and window size k, return an array of the max value in each window as it slides from left to right.

title: Max Consecutive Ones III
description: Given a binary array nums and integer k, return the max number of consecutive 1's obtainable if you can flip at most k 0's.

title: Fruit Into Baskets
description: Given an array fruits representing tree types in a row, you have two baskets each holding one type of fruit. Return the max number of fruits you can collect from a contiguous subarray using at most 2 distinct types.

title: Longest Substring with At Most K Distinct Characters
description: Given a string s and integer k, return the length of the longest substring that contains at most k distinct characters.

title: Binary Subarrays With Sum
description: Given a binary array nums and integer goal, return the number of non-empty subarrays with a sum equal to goal.

title: Maximum Average Subarray I
description: Given an array nums of n integers and integer k, find a contiguous subarray of length k with the maximum average value, and return it.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of distinct integers nums and target, return the index of target or -1 if not found. Must run in O(log n).

title: Search Insert Position
description: Given a sorted array of distinct integers nums and target, return the index if found, or the index where it would be inserted in order.

title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
description: Given a sorted array nums and target, find the starting and ending position of target. Return [-1,-1] if not found. Must run in O(log n).

title: Sqrt(x)
description: Given a non-negative integer x, return the square root of x rounded down to the nearest integer, without using built-in exponent functions.

title: Find Peak Element
description: A peak element is strictly greater than its neighbors. Given an integer array nums, return the index of any peak element (nums[-1]=nums[n]=-infinity assumed). Must run in O(log n).

title: Koko Eating Bananas
description: Koko has piles of bananas and h hours to eat them all, eating at most one pile per hour at speed k bananas/hour. Return the minimum integer eating speed k such that she can eat all bananas within h hours.

title: Search a 2D Matrix
description: Given an m x n matrix with rows sorted and each row's first element greater than the previous row's last, return true if target exists. Must run in O(log(mn)).

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2, return the median of the two combined sorted arrays.

title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
description: Given package weights shipped in order within days days, return the minimum ship capacity (weight/day) to ship all packages in D days.

title: Single Element in a Sorted Array
description: Given a sorted array where every element appears exactly twice except one which appears once, return that single element in O(log n) time.

title: Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix
description: Given an n x n matrix where each row and column is sorted ascending, and integer k, return the kth smallest element in the matrix.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing just '()[]{}' characters, return true if the string is valid (brackets closed in correct order).

title: Min Stack Operations
description: Simulate a MinStack supporting push(x), pop(), top(), getMin() in O(1) each. Given lists of ops and args, return the list of results for top/getMin calls (null for push/pop).

title: Daily Temperatures
description: Given an array of integers temperatures, return an array answer such that answer[i] is the number of days until a warmer temperature; 0 if none.

title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
description: Given an array of tokens representing an arithmetic expression in Reverse Polish Notation, evaluate the expression and return an integer result.

title: Next Greater Element I
description: Given two arrays nums1 (subset of nums2) and nums2 with distinct elements, for each element in nums1 find its next greater element to the right in nums2, or -1.

title: Implement Queue using Stacks
description: Simulate a FIFO queue using only two stacks, supporting push(x), pop(), peek(), empty(). Given ops and args, return list of results (null for push).

title: Remove K Digits
description: Given a non-negative integer num as a string and integer k, remove k digits to make the number as small as possible. Return the result as a string with no leading zeroes (unless the number is '0').

title: Asteroid Collision
description: Given an array of integers asteroids where sign indicates direction (right/left) and magnitude is size, simulate collisions (smaller explodes, equal both explode) and return the resulting state.

title: Simplify Path
description: Given an absolute Unix-style file path, simplify it (resolve '.' and '..' and duplicate slashes) and return the canonical path.

title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
description: Given an array of integers heights representing histogram bar heights (width 1 each), return the area of the largest rectangle in the histogram.

title: Car Fleet
description: n cars at given positions and speeds are heading to target on a one-lane road. A car catching up to a slower one forms a fleet (can't pass). Return the number of fleets that arrive at target.

title: Next Smaller Element
description: Given an integer array nums, for each element find the next smaller element to its right. Return -1 if none exists.

title: Reverse Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list represented as an array of node values, return the array reversed (representing the reversed list).

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: Given the heads of two sorted linked lists (as arrays), merge them into one sorted array representing the merged list.

title: Linked List Cycle
description: Given the values of a linked list nodeVals and pos, the index the tail connects to (-1 if no cycle), return true if the list has a cycle.

title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
description: Given the head of a linked list (as array) and integer n, remove the nth node from the end and return the resulting array.

title: Reorder List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list L0-L1-...-Ln (as array), reorder it to L0-Ln-L1-Ln-1-... Return the resulting array.

title: Add Two Numbers
description: Given two non-empty linked lists (as arrays) representing two non-negative integers in reverse digit order, add them and return the sum as a linked list (array) in reverse order.

title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
description: Given two linked lists (as arrays listA, listB) that may intersect after skipA and skipB nodes respectively (shared tail), return the intersected tail portion (empty list if none).

title: Palindrome Linked List
description: Given the head of a singly linked list (as array), return true if it is a palindrome.

title: Reverse Linked List II
description: Given the head of a linked list (as array) and integers left, right, reverse the nodes from position left to right (1-indexed) and return the resulting array.

title: Odd Even Linked List
description: Given the head of a linked list (as array), group all nodes at odd indices together followed by nodes at even indices (1-indexed positions), preserving relative order. Return the resulting array.

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree as a level-order array (null for missing nodes), return its maximum depth.

title: Same Tree
description: Given the level-order arrays of two binary trees p and q, return true if they are structurally identical with the same node values.

title: Invert Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree as a level-order array, invert the tree (swap every left/right child) and return the level-order array of the result (trailing nulls trimmed).

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree as a level-order array, determine if it is a valid binary search tree.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Given the root of a binary tree as a level-order array, return the level order traversal of node values grouped by level.

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree as a level-order array, return the length (number of edges) of the longest path between any two nodes.

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
description: Given the root of a BST as a level-order array and two node values p, q, return the value of their lowest common ancestor.

title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
description: Given the root of a BST as a level-order array and integer k, return the kth smallest value in the tree.

title: Symmetric Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree as a level-order array, check whether it is a mirror of itself (symmetric around its center).

title: Path Sum
description: Given the root of a binary tree as a level-order array and an integer targetSum, return true if the tree has a root-to-leaf path such that the values sum to targetSum.

title: Number of Islands
description: Given an m x n binary grid representing land (1) and water (0), return the number of islands (connected land, horizontally/vertically).

title: Clone Graph Node Count
description: Given an adjacency list adjList representing a connected undirected graph, return the number of nodes in the graph (a proxy check for correct cloning traversal).

title: Course Schedule
description: Given numCourses and a list of prerequisite pairs [a,b] meaning take b before a, return true if it is possible to finish all courses (no cycle).

title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
description: Given an m x n grid of heights, return a sorted list of coordinates [r,c] from which water can flow to both the Pacific (top/left edges) and Atlantic (bottom/right edges) oceans.

title: Rotting Oranges
description: Given a grid where 0=empty, 1=fresh orange, 2=rotten orange, every minute a rotten orange rots adjacent fresh ones. Return the minimum minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if impossible.

title: Graph Valid Tree
description: Given n nodes labeled 0..n-1 and a list of undirected edges, return true if the edges form a valid tree (connected, acyclic).

title: Network Delay Time
description: Given times[i]=[u,v,w] (directed edge u->v with weight w), n nodes labeled 1..n, and source node k, return the minimum time for all nodes to receive a signal sent from k, or -1 if impossible.

examples.explanation: shortest time for signal to reach all

title: Flood Fill
description: Given an image grid, a starting pixel (sr,sc), and a new color, perform a flood fill (4-directionally connected pixels of the same original color) and return the modified image.

title: Word Ladder
description: Given beginWord, endWord, and a wordList, return the length of the shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord changing one letter at a time (each intermediate word must be in wordList), or 0 if no such sequence exists.

title: Find Center of Star Graph
description: Given edges of a star graph (one central node connected to all others), return the label of the center node.

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
description: Given an integer array nums and integer k, return the kth largest element (not the kth distinct element).

title: Top K Frequent Words
description: Given an array of strings words and integer k, return the k most frequent strings, sorted by frequency (descending), ties broken alphabetically.

title: Merge K Sorted Lists
description: Given an array of k sorted integer lists, merge them into one sorted list and return it.

title: Task Scheduler
description: Given a char array tasks and integer n (cooldown between same tasks), return the minimum number of intervals (including idles) to complete all tasks.

examples.explanation: A B idle A B idle A B

title: K Closest Points to Origin
description: Given an array of points on the X-Y plane and integer k, return the k points closest to the origin (Euclidean distance), sorted by distance ascending.

title: Find Median from Data Stream
description: Given a stream of integers nums added one at a time, return an array where the ith element is the median of all elements added so far (after adding nums[i]).

title: Subsets
description: Given an integer array nums of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set), sorted by size then lexicographically.

title: Permutations
description: Given an array nums of distinct integers, return all possible permutations, sorted lexicographically.

title: Combination Sum
description: Given an array of distinct positive integers candidates and target, return all unique combinations where chosen numbers sum to target (numbers may be reused unlimited times), sorted.

title: N-Queens (Count Solutions)
description: Given an integer n, return the number of distinct solutions to the n-queens puzzle (placing n queens on an n x n board so no two attack each other).

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You are climbing a staircase of n steps. You can climb 1 or 2 steps at a time. Return the number of distinct ways to reach the top.

title: House Robber
description: Given an array nums representing money in houses along a street, where adjacent houses can't both be robbed, return the max money you can rob.

title: House Robber II
description: Same as House Robber but houses are arranged in a circle (first and last are adjacent). Return the max money you can rob.

title: Coin Change
description: Given coin denominations coins and a total amount, return the fewest number of coins needed to make up that amount, or -1 if impossible.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

title: Unique Paths
description: There is a robot on an m x n grid starting at top-left, moving only right or down, trying to reach bottom-right. Return the number of unique paths.

title: Unique Paths II
description: Same as Unique Paths, but some cells contain obstacles (1=obstacle, 0=free) which the robot cannot enter. Return the number of unique paths from top-left to bottom-right.

title: Longest Common Subsequence
description: Given two strings text1 and text2, return the length of their longest common subsequence, or 0 if none exists.

title: Edit Distance
description: Given two strings word1 and word2, return the minimum number of operations (insert, delete, replace) to convert word1 into word2.

title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
description: Given a non-empty array of positive integers nums, return true if it can be partitioned into two subsets with equal sum.

title: Decode Ways
description: A message containing letters A-Z is encoded using 'A'->1,...,'Z'->26. Given a string s of digits, return the number of ways to decode it.

title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
description: Given an array cost where cost[i] is the cost of stepping on step i, and you can start from step 0 or 1 and climb 1 or 2 steps at a time, return the minimum cost to reach the top (beyond the last index).
